name: Quantum mechanics bridge
description: Quantum mechanics bridge plugin for HoloScript. Wraps Psi4 (CCSD molecular), Quantum ESPRESSO (DFT solid-state), TBLite (semi-empirical), IBM Quantum (VQE/QAOA circuits), and PySCF (PBC/materials DFT + OpenFermion Hamiltonian export) under unified SimulationContract scale-tag dispatch.
